newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chi Cheung mulls US$35 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Chi Cheung mulls US$35 mln bond issue.

text.p: Property and financial investment company Chi Cheung Investment Co Ltd said on Thursday it is considering issuing convertible guaranteed bonds of up to US$35 million.
The terms of the proposed issue are expected to be finalised around mid-June, the company said in a statement.
It has applied for the listing of the bonds on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange, it said.
The company will announce further details of the proposed issue on or around Friday, it said.
Chi Cheung said it has no immediate plan to spin off its property agency business.
